description: This satellite image shows a landscape dominated by non-irrigated agricultural fields in Northern Germany, captured on 2012-07-27 by Spot 5 satellite at a 2.5 m resolution. The image uses a 1/2/3 band combination, typically a false-colour infrared composite where healthy vegetation appears reddish. The majority of the agricultural fields are irregularly shaped parcels, appearing in shades of light beige, green, and brown, suggesting dry, fallow, or harvested land. Some areas, particularly in the lower right, exhibit more pronounced reddish-brown tones, indicating active vegetation or different land cover types within the false-colour rendition. The upper part of the image shows areas with a more natural, muted green-brown hue, possibly representing natural terrain or less intensely managed land.
